markdown_content:
The Company entered into a second sublease agreement at its headquarters, effective July 1, 2018 with a portfolio company in which one of the Company's Directors is an investor. Rental income from the sublease was approximately $45,000 quarterly. This sublease agreement was terminated in December, 2019.
